svg.title: X. Wheel of Fortune: Nyxpkgs
svg.desc: X. Wheel of Fortune, upright. Nix. collection of packages not found in Nixpkgs. Artwork from scanned Gustave Doré Inferno engravings, first published in 1861.

g.desc: Gustave Doré, Inferno (1861), The Minotaur. https://archive.org/details/dantesinferno00dantuoft; scan leaf 153. Public domain: nineteenth-century engravings; Doré died in 1883. The digitizing collection records NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT.
